name: Lawrence Foods, Inc.

about:
Lawrence Foods, Inc. has operated from Elk Grove Village, Illinois since its founding in 1890 by Major Lawrence. The company remains family-owned, tracing its roots to the establishment of Ad. Seidel & Son, Inc. and Hilker & Bletsch in Chicago before Lawrence Foods expanded.

As a broadline manufacturer of premium bakery ingredients, the company produces icings, fruit fillings, crème fillings, dry mixes, fondant, glazes, fruit preparations, jellies and preserves, nutrition bar components, and savory spreads. Production takes place in a 293,000-square-foot facility that houses formulation, packaging, and a working baking environment used for product testing and development.

Lawrence Foods serves retail bakery operations of all sizes, commercial food manufacturers, in-store supermarket bakeries, foodservice operators, and distributors across the United States. Its customer base spans the baking industry from large-scale industrial producers to small independent shops.

The company differentiates itself by not owning orchards or agricultural processing plants, allowing it to source fruit from the freshest seasonal regions. A dedicated technical team including a chief chemist, food technologists, and master bakers works alongside clients to develop ingredient solutions, supported by SQF Level 3 certification held for the past five years.
